title: Adaptive-capacity embedding plus rare-token Mirror views
hypothesis: Under a Zipf token distribution, a frequency-banded embedding with rare-token rank-4 shared bases and one Givens View angle per rare token will improve tail-token accuracy by >=0.05 over both a same-byte uniform embedding and the same rare-token basis without Mirror, while keeping head accuracy within 0.02 of the ordinary adaptive baseline and overall NLL within 0.02; total inference bytes should be <=0.85x adaptive input embeddings.
physical_object: full-dimensional head embeddings, medium-band embeddings, and one shared rank-4 basis for rare tokens
mirror_coordinate: one per-rare-token Givens angle rotating the rank-4 reconstruction in 32D
logical_multiplicity: 768 rare-token embedding views from shared basis parameters plus individual low-dimensional token codes

model.labels: token_id mod 8; all methods share same sampled token sequences within each seed

controls: independent full 32D embedding table upper control
ordinary adaptive input: dimensions 32/16/8 for head/middle/tail
rare-token shared rank-4 basis without per-token Mirror View
same rare-token rank-4 basis plus scalar token gain
Mirror rare-token rank-4 basis plus one per-token Givens angle; head/middle allocations identical to ordinary adaptive input
development_gate_before_fresh: In both development seeds: Mirror tail-band accuracy >=0.05 above both uniform12 and tail-basis-without-view; head-band accuracy within 0.02 of adaptive input; overall test NLL <= adaptive NLL +0.02; and Mirror full serialized bytes <=0.85x adaptive input. Otherwise fresh remains sealed.
success_gate: All three fresh seeds meet tail/head/overall-NLL/byte gates with exact reloaded payload replay; report per-band token coverage, NLL, accuracy, bytes, runtime and throughput.
failure_gate: Any development gate misses in either seed; fresh stays sealed.

storage.authority: actual deterministic ZIP/NPY FP16 inference payload after reload

boundaries: synthetic token classification with Zipf sampling; not natural LM evidence
same Zipf sample sequences within each seed for all methods
per-band frequency counts are determined before training
fixed update performance is not a capacity claim
fresh seeds unopened until every development gate passes
